createdBy.cmd: design sketch new elements/day-lanes --variants a,b,c --product timetrack --by claude-opus-5-5 --variant-note a=Subagent as a thin sub-stripe inside the parent lane, parent colour at a lower tone; short ones a tick on the parent band. Costs: a narrower parent band, the task label must fit a 3rem stripe. --variant-note b=Subagent as an indented sub-row under the parent lane, joined by a bracket; short ones listed in the parent detail. Costs: one extra column per session with subagents, the day gets wider. --variant-note c=Subagent as a full-width parallel lane marked as a child (agent glyph + parent name). Costs: reads like a second session, contradicts ADR 0052; baseline for contrast.

rounds.title: Subagent beside its session
rounds.note: Same 19.11.-shaped day three ways: a stripe inside the session lane, an indented sub-row with a bracket, a full child lane as the second-session baseline.

a.note: Subagent as a thin sub-stripe inside the parent lane, parent colour at a lower tone; short ones a tick on the parent band. Costs: a narrower parent band, the task label must fit a 3rem stripe.

b.note: Subagent as an indented sub-row under the parent lane, joined by a bracket; short ones listed in the parent detail. Costs: one extra column per session with subagents, the day gets wider.

c.note: Subagent as a full-width parallel lane marked as a child (agent glyph + parent name). Costs: reads like a second session, contradicts ADR 0052; baseline for contrast.
